HOME.HERO_TITLE: Living water, light garden, true zen
HOME.HERO_LEAD: Ponds full of life — design, construction, maintenance and reliable equipment.
HOME.HERO_IMAGE_ALT: Swimming pond at sunset with loungers by the water
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT: We are a small, close-knit team of passionate craftspeople specialising in natural ponds and swimming ponds. Our specialists master earthwork techniques, precise stone laying, complex sanitary systems and safe electrical work. We can take on the entire project turnkey or help you with specific complex tasks.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_2: We work successfully across the Netherlands, bringing pond projects of any complexity, type and size to life. We do not build standard water features; instead we create living works of art that perform flawlessly. Ecological materials, clean filtration and natural lines make ponds that last for years — and bring joy.
HOME.PHILOSOPHY_1_TEXT: Balanced forms, calm lines and a natural transition between water and garden — so every pond fits organically into its surroundings.
HOME.PHILOSOPHY_2_TEXT: Precise filtration, pipework and electrical systems that perform reliably — built to stay clear and stable for years.
HOME.PHILOSOPHY_3_TEXT: Sustainable choices in stone, planting and finishing that grow with the garden and strengthen its natural character.
HOME.PHILOSOPHY_4_TEXT: Clear agreements, honest communication and a handover you can trust — from first sketch to aftercare.
HOME.PROCESS_TEXT: Every project starts with a site visit: we look at the garden, the soil and your wishes, then develop a concrete plan with schedule and cost estimate. During construction we adapt to what the situation requires, keep you informed of progress and only hand over when everything is right.
HOME.PROCESS_INVITE: Do you already have a clear plan? Or do you only know that you want something special for your garden? We are happy to think along with you. Contact us for a no-obligation introduction.

PONDS.TITLE: Pond concepts
PONDS.SUBTITLE: Choose a concept for more details on construction, comfort and technology.
PONDS.ITEM_1_ALT: Naturalistic organic pond with water lilies and lush garden planting
PONDS.ITEM_1_TEXT:
Such ponds are shaped without strict artificial lines, creating a smooth, natural transition between your garden and the water surface. Form and depth of each project are adapted to the landscape — from a shallow shoreline with marginal plants to a deeper central area.

With pure craftsmanship we select and lay robust river pebbles and natural stone on a reliable EPDM liner base. Thanks to smart biological filtration with helophytes and lava rock, the water stays crystal clear all year — without a single drop of chemical additives.
PONDS.ITEM_1_TEXT_AFTER: Every natural pond is designed as an individual project, tailored to your plot and wishes.
PONDS.ITEM_1_THESIS_1_TEXT: We select modern circulation pumps and pre-filtration systems that use little energy while keeping the water constantly fresh.
PONDS.ITEM_1_THESIS_2_TEXT: Subtle underwater or shoreline lighting gently accentuates the stone structure and creates a pleasant setting to relax by the water after sunset.
PONDS.ITEM_1_THESIS_3_TEXT: The pond lives by the laws of nature, so maintenance comes down to seasonal plant care and occasional planned filter checks.
PONDS.ITEM_2_ALT: Crystal-clear koi pond with colourful koi and a natural stone edge
PONDS.ITEM_2_TEXT:
Designing and building a pond for koi carp requires a special approach that accounts for the unique biology of these fish. Koi are highly sensitive to their environment: for comfortable keeping you need the right depth so the water does not overheat in summer or freeze solid in winter. Reinforced filtration is also critical, able to handle their waste products immediately.

We include professional bottom drains, skimmers and UV cleaning systems already at the design stage. As a result, the pond water stays crystal clear, the biological balance remains stable, and the fish stay healthy and active. At the owner’s request, shallower viewing zones can be created alongside the deep zone for comfortable viewing and feeding.
PONDS.ITEM_2_THESIS_1_TEXT: A complete mechanical and biological cleaning system combined with UV-C sterilisation guarantees crystal-clear water. A powerful aeration system continuously saturates the pond with oxygen, creating ideal conditions for active, healthy fish.
PONDS.ITEM_2_THESIS_2_TEXT: We integrate modern solutions for automatic monitoring of key water parameters and smart feeding systems. That keeps the bio-balance stable and frees you from manual routine.
PONDS.ITEM_2_THESIS_3_TEXT: Professionally designed bottom drains and skimmers collect waste before it starts to break down. Filter equipment maintenance is limited to rare scheduled checks that do not disturb the pond’s inhabitants.
PONDS.ITEM_2_TEXT_AFTER: Every koi pond is created as an autonomous, safe ecosystem to a custom design — strictly tailored to your plot and the planned number of fish.
PONDS.ITEM_3_ALT: Luxury swimming pond with a stone edge at sunset in a well-kept garden
PONDS.ITEM_3A_ALT: Luxury swimming pond with a stone edge at sunset in a well-kept garden
PONDS.ITEM_3A_TEXT: This intimate water feature is seamlessly integrated into the geometry of the garden, forming an oasis of calm, sheltered from the outside world. Surrounded by flowers and greenery, it offers a sense of seclusion and peace within familiar home walls. Early in the morning, just a few steps from the door, you can sit on the terrace with a cup of coffee watching light play on the mirror-smooth surface — or dive straight into the refreshing cool of clear water.
PONDS.ITEM_3A_THESIS_1_TEXT: We design modern, efficient filtration systems that ensure continuous water circulation and keep it impeccably fresh and clean without stagnation.
PONDS.ITEM_3A_THESIS_2_TEXT: Thoughtful underwater and deck lighting softly outlines the pond edges in the dark. It allows safe, comfortable swimming in the evening and creates a stunning visual effect.
PONDS.ITEM_3A_THESIS_3_TEXT: All equipment runs automatically. Maintenance is limited to rare scheduled checks of the technical system, so you can simply enjoy the quiet.
PONDS.ITEM_3A_TEXT_AFTER: Every such project is designed strictly individually, so the water basin fits perfectly into the geometry and dimensions of your garden.
PONDS.ITEM_3B_ALT: Minimalist swimming pond with a wooden deck in a wooded garden
PONDS.ITEM_3B_TEXT: This simple, minimalist swimming pond is designed as an organic extension of the wooden terrace and cosy barbecue area, creating one space for relaxation. The clean elongated shape with a rounded edge perfectly underlines the modern aesthetic of the plot without overloading the landscape with unnecessary detail.
PONDS.ITEM_3B_THESIS_1_TEXT: Modern automatic filtration systems keep circulation continuous, guaranteeing impeccable freshness, cleanliness and clarity of water without stagnation.
PONDS.ITEM_3B_THESIS_2_TEXT: Thoughtful underwater and deck lighting softly outlines the smooth contours of the pond and the terrace edges in the dark. It makes evening swimming fully safe and turns the pond into the main jewel of the night garden.
PONDS.ITEM_3B_THESIS_3_TEXT: All engineering equipment runs autonomously. Maintenance is limited to rare scheduled checks of the technical system, so you can simply enjoy relaxing and spending time with loved ones.
PONDS.ITEM_3B_TEXT_AFTER: Every such project is designed individually to harmoniously unite the pond basin, terrace decking and the landscape of your plot.

GALLERY.TITLE: Our work
GALLERY.SUBTITLE: A selection of completed projects.
GALLERY.ITEM_1_TITLE: Construction and renovation of an 80 m² organic pond
GALLERY.ITEM_1_ALT: Renovation of an organic pond of about 80 m² with EPDM and natural stone
GALLERY.ITEM_1_INTRO: We want to present this project through the review of our grateful client — an honest account of the renovation and our collaboration.
GALLERY.ITEM_1_DETAIL_1_ALT: Natural shoreline with water plants and stones of the renovated organic pond
GALLERY.ITEM_1_DETAIL_1_CAPTION: Nature takes over — we only set the right direction.
GALLERY.ITEM_1_DETAIL_2_ALT: Detail of natural stone shoreline and clear water of the renovated organic pond
GALLERY.ITEM_1_DETAIL_2_CAPTION: We finished the spring in stone, from which the pond is fed.
GALLERY.ITEM_1_TEXT:
The job was to pump out and renovate an old pond of about 80 m².

Vitalii responded quickly to our request via Werkspot. After visiting the site we quickly reached an agreement. All arrangements were recorded in a contract, including a guarantee on the work carried out.

Vitalii worked hard and quickly removed a layer of about 10 cm of water plants and wind-blown sand. It then became clear that the old pond liner was considerably worse than we had initially thought. Vitalii advised replacing it with EPDM and also took on the extra work. Despite the extra cost, this proved to be the right and professional decision.

Now we can swim in our own pond ourselves — and in warm weather we have already done so several times.

As part of our project Vitalii also created a beautiful natural-stone stream, planted the vegetation and installed all the necessary equipment.

We especially appreciate that Vital has broad knowledge and his own network of materials and equipment for creating and renovating water landscapes. From small parts and consumables to professional filters, pumps and UV equipment for ponds. Thanks to this, all solutions for our project were delivered professionally and comprehensively — without searching for different specialists and suppliers.

And after the project was completed, Vitalii is always available for advice and help.
GALLERY.ITEM_2_ALT: Construction of a tiered waterfall pond with slate mosaic
GALLERY.ITEM_2_TEXT: For this exclusive project the client asked for a dynamic water feature on several levels, inspired by a natural mountain stream. We chose a tiered structure with terrace platforms. The real challenge lay in the artistic stonework: manually sorting and laying flat layered slate in a fan-shaped mosaic pattern. Each stone layer is precisely aligned with a special frost-resistant pond mortar to create a harmonious pattern of flowing lines. This structural craftsmanship will form the perfect base for a cascading waterfall that provides a soothing babbling sound and optimal oxygenation of the water.
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_1_ALT: Pond excavation lined with protective geotextile
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_1_TEXT: After the earthworks are finished, the excavation is fully lined with a two-layer non-woven geotextile. This sturdy ‘cushion’ levels the base and reliably protects the future waterproofing from punctures by sharp stones, tree roots and accidental ground damage.
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_2_ALT: Pond basin with installed EPDM waterproofing membrane
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_2_TITLE: Stage 2: Installing the main waterproofing membrane
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_2_TEXT: Over the geotextile a professional EPDM membrane (butyl rubber) is unrolled and carefully smoothed. This elastic, durable material ensures the pond’s full watertightness, withstands frost and UV and holds the water in the basin.
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_3_ALT: First filling of the pond with water and primary shoreline landscaping
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_3_TITLE: Stage 3: First water fill and primary landscaping
GALLERY.PROCESS_STEP_3_TEXT: The pond is carefully filled with water, under which the membrane takes its final shape. In the same phase the shoreline is shaped, the first water plants are placed in the regeneration zone and decorative boulders are laid for a natural landscape.

EQUIPMENT.TITLE: Equipment & accessories
EQUIPMENT.SUBTITLE: Reliable technology and care products for a clear, healthy pond.
EQUIPMENT.PUMPS_TEXT: Energy-efficient circulation and filter pumps matched to your pond volume and desired flow. We recommend quiet, durable systems that keep working reliably for years.
EQUIPMENT.FILTERS_TEXT: Biological, mechanical and UV-C filters for crystal-clear water. From compact sets to powerful multi-stage systems — always matched to your pond type.
EQUIPMENT.LIGHTING_TEXT: Atmospheric underwater and shoreline lighting that brings your pond to life in the evening. Discrete, safe fixtures with a natural light character.
EQUIPMENT.CARE_TEXT: Responsible products for water quality, algae control and plant health. We choose environmentally friendly products that support your pond’s ecosystem.

MATERIALS.TITLE: Building materials
MATERIALS.SUBTITLE: Durable materials for a strong, natural and long-lasting pond construction.
MATERIALS.STONE_TEXT: Natural stone, river pebbles and slate for shores, waterfalls and finishing. Every project gets a carefully selected stone range that fits garden and style.
MATERIALS.LINER_TEXT: High-quality EPDM liner as a waterproof, flexible base. Resistant to frost, root pressure and UV — built for decades of reliable use.
MATERIALS.GEOTEXTILE_TEXT: Protective fabric under the liner that catches sharp stones and roots. Essential for the lifespan of the pond floor and a stable base.
MATERIALS.CEMENT_TEXT: Special frost- and water-resistant pond mortar for stone setting and structural details. Environmentally friendly mixes that are safe for flora and fauna.
MATERIALS.DECKING_TEXT: Durable decking for paths, terraces and swim zones. We choose materials that withstand moisture and connect seamlessly to the pond edge.
